input_contract.row_constraints: 0<=a<v<=K; a is64-aligned; v-a<=S; a<=c<=v. Hence all valid global Q coordinates q lie in[a,a+S).

phase_review.reason: Output row r=a+block*M+local; Q/U pointer(head bh*S-a)*D+r*D equals(bh*S+r-a)*D. Keys begin0 and advance only below min(v,row0+M); K/V use kv_bh*K. LSE/tau/center index bh*S+q-a has0<=q-a<S whenever q<v. Valid load predicates use v-row0 or v-col0, and v<=a+S.
The owner Q/U tile uses S and per-row a, RHS K/V history uses K; causal/global coordinates and original coefficient start filtering remain. Stores require r<a+S and select zero unless r<v and r>=c.

Owner K/V tile uses compact kv_bh*K; RHS Q/U uses bh*S-a. Query columns start at row0>=a and end below v<=a+S, while coefficients are stored in query-head S layout. Causal q>=k and c>=a mean requested K/V coefficients require no queries before the available cached Q suffix.

phase_review.result: Every S output position has a source-level writer
phase_review.reason: ceil(S/M) tiles partition local rows[0,S). Entire invalid/coefficient-skipped tiles write zero below a+S; partial invalid tails are zeroed by final r<v predicates. a+S may exceed K: rows at or after v take uniform early zero branch, and v<=K prevents K/V reads there. Queries or keys below v are still bounded by the correct independent storage extent.
